context: Two athletes prep for a match at a big stadium
purpose: Teach: スタジアム/最強/青春/最大限/前進/レッド/強度/失う

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 見ろよ、このスタジアム。ホームの試合でこんなに観客が入るなんて初めてだ。
lines.en: Look at this stadium. I've never seen so many spectators at a home game.
lines.style: Awestruck upperclassman pointing out the massive crowd.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 緊張してきた…相手は今シーズン最強のチームっすよね。
lines.en: I'm getting nervous... the opponent is the strongest team this season, right?
lines.style: Younger teammate showing honest pre-match nerves.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: だからこそ燃えるんだろ。今この瞬間が俺たちの青春なんだから、楽しまないと損だぞ。
lines.en: That's exactly why it's exciting. This moment is our youth — we'd lose out by not enjoying it.
lines.style: Encouraging senior framing the match as a youthful highlight.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 確かに…持ってる力を最大限に出し切るしかないですね。
lines.en: True... we just have to give everything we've got to the fullest.
lines.style: Younger player steeling his resolve with quiet determination.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうだ。一歩でも前進すれば結果はついてくる。コーチも練習の強度を上げてきたしな。
lines.en: Right. If we advance even one step, results will follow. Coach has ramped up the practice intensity too.
lines.style: Senior reassuring with practical confidence about preparation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あ、でも気をつけてくださいよ。前回みたいにレッドカードもらったら、マジで終わりっす。
lines.en: Oh, but please be careful. If you get a red card like last time, it's really over.
lines.style: Teasing reminder about a past mistake, half-joking tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うるさいな、あれは事故だって。冷静さを失うつもりはない。
lines.en: Shut up, that was an accident. I don't intend to lose my cool.
lines.style: Mock-defensive senior brushing off the jab firmly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ信じてますよ、先輩。行きましょう!
lines.en: Then I'm trusting you, senpai. Let's go!
lines.style: Junior closing with bright, energetic team spirit.
